title: The Clock Chimes Contradiction
description:
📂 Evidence Folder #7:
Witness C: 'I heard the parlor grandfather clock chime 12 full times at 12:30 AM.'
Clockmaker Inspection: The parlor clock chimes once at half-past, and hour counts only at the top of the hour.
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Grandfather clocks chime once on half-hours.
Witness C claims 12 chimes at 12:30 AM.
solution: Grandfather clocks chime only once at half-hours. Witness C lied about hearing 12 chimes at 12:30.
